entities.summary: Tonga is a sovereign nation in Polynesia, Oceania. Its capital is Nuku'alofa. Official languages include Tongan, English. Government: Unitary parliamentary constitutional monarchy. Population: approximately 0.1 million. Area: 747 km². Comprehensive index for Tonga covering Lapita settlement (~1500 BCE), Tu'i Tonga Empire (950-1865, one of largest Pacific empires, ruled from Samoa to Niue), Ha'a Tui Kanokupolu dynasty, never colonised (only Pacific nation never fully colonised, British protectorate 1900-1970 but retained sovereignty), Christian conversion (King George Tupōu I 1831), Constitution 1875 (one of oldest in Pacific), independence/sovereignty restoration 1970, pro-democracy movement 2006 riots, Hunga Tonga–Hunga Ha'apai eruption 2022.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Tonga's unique history as a never-colonized Pacific nation and its restoration of sovereignty in 1970 has significant regional implications for Polynesian identity and self-governance. Its independence has allowed it to maintain cultural traditions while engaging with the modern world.
